# CSCI 1260 GUIs and Events Lab, C++ version. Do not edit this file.
#
#   cmake -S . -B build        set up the build folder (once)
#   cmake --build build        build (after every change)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(GuiEventsLab LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Qt reads the Q_OBJECT line in MainWindow.h and writes extra code for it.
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)

add_executable(gui_events_lab
    main.cpp
    Event.h
    NotFinished.h
    Order.h
    Order.cpp
    OrderEventArgs.h
    OrderEventArgs.cpp
    CoffeeBar.h
    CoffeeBar.cpp
    PickupScreen.h
    PickupScreen.cpp
    Buzzer.h
    Buzzer.cpp
    Rewards.h
    Rewards.cpp
    MainWindow.h
    MainWindow.cpp
    LabCheck.h
    LabCheck.cpp
    WindowDriver.h
    WindowDriver.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(gui_events_lab PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets)

# Extra warnings on GCC and Clang. Event handlers often ignore their sender,
# so the unused parameter warning is turned off.
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(gui_events_lab PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
endif()
